messages:
alex: ACME escalation — their tenant console shows no p95/p99 lines after last night's proxy config flip. Customer ticket INC-8421. They say panels are just blank where tails should be.

jason: Can you paste a screenshot and the org/tenant id?

alex: https://acme.company/snap/console-metrics.png  tenant=acme-123  severity=high. Customer says paid SLA.

maria: :eyes: I'm also seeing empty tails on our internal tenant view for acme-123. Quick check: running a direct query against metrics-api for p95 for that tenant returns 200 but no series filtered by tenant. Example query I used: `query=histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by(le, version) (rate(request_duration_seconds_bucket{org="acme",tenant="acme-123"}[5m])))` — returns no series.

alex: I grabbed raw ingestion events from the edge for the timeframe of the deploy. Snippet from telemetry-agent logs:
```
2026-03-16T21:03:12Z telemetry-agent[edge-proxy-3] INFO labels_before={org=acme,tenant=acme-123,env=prod}
2026-03-16T21:03:12Z telemetry-agent[edge-proxy-3] INFO transform=label_drop tenant applied
2026-03-16T21:03:12Z telemetry-agent[edge-proxy-3] INFO labels_after={org=acme,env=prod}
```
Looks like the tenant label is being dropped during the forwarding transform.

sre-jen: Confirmed — we deployed telemetry-agent v2.4.1 with a config change intended to normalize tenant labels into `org` for the org-level dashboards. The change contained `drop_labels: ["tenant"]` and it shipped to all edge proxies in the cutover window (21:00–21:10). That inadvertently removed tenant scoping for tenant-level dashboards.

jason: Oof. That would make tenant-scoped panels show nothing since the dashboards filter on `tenant`. Two action items: revert the config on edge canary first, and provide a temporary dashboard query for ACME that uses `org` only so they have p95/p99 visible.

support-bot: Created incident INC-8421 | Severity: 2 | Owner: alex | ETA: initial response < 30m. Notified on-call and customer.

maria: Temporary query to share with the customer (copy into their dashboard panels):
```
# replace tenant filter with org filter
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, org) (rate(request_duration_seconds_bucket{org="acme"}[5m])))
```
This will show p95/p99 by org, which at least surfaces tails until we restore tenant labels.

alex: I've messaged ACME with that workaround and a short status: "we've identified an agent config change that removed tenant labels. We're rolling a revert to canary now; full fix ETA 2-3 hours."

jason: I'm opening a hotfix PR to flip `drop_labels` back off and add a config guard. PR: https://github.com/redwood/telemetry-agent/pull/482 — will push to canary (10%) first.

sre-jen: Running canary revert now: `kubectl -n telemetry set env deploy/telemetry-agent TELEMETRY_DROP_TENANT=false --record` then restarting pods on canary subset. Monitoring logs for label preservation.

emily: I'll post the temporary dashboard snippet and the incident summary to ACME, plus confirm billing is unaffected. Also collecting the customer's repro steps to attach to the ticket.

maria: After canary is healthy, we'll roll to 100%. Also adding a metrics unit test to ensure tenant label isn't dropped unless an explicit org-migration flag is set.

alex: Thanks. Please ping here when canary is green and when full rollback completes. Customer wants next update in 45m. :thumbsup:

sre-jen: Canary revert completed at 21:38 UTC — verified tenant label preserved in incoming metrics:
```
2026-03-16T21:38:22Z telemetry-agent[edge-proxy-canary] INFO labels_after={org=acme,tenant=acme-123,env=prod}
```
Metrics panels for acme-123 now show p95/p99 again on canary dashboards.

jason: Kicking full roll now. Rolling update in progress.

support-bot: INC-8421 updated: revert deployed to production at 22:05 UTC. Customer notified.

alex: Customer confirms tails are back on their tenant console. Closing loop. Will file a postmortem and add a deploy checklist item to avoid label-drop regresses.

emily: Posting resolution to the ticket and asking ACME if they want a private postmortem.

maria: Action items: 1) PR 482 merged and backported, 2) add unit test & deploy-gate, 3) create alert for sudden drop of tenant-tagged series.

alex: Thanks all — great quick turnaround. :raised_hands:
